description: Event uploads to the Amplitude HTTP V2 API, including the JSON event payload. Identify is vendor/amplitude-identify. Group identify is vendor/amplitude-group-identify.

params.name: api_key
params.description: It is the project API key the upload is attributed to.
params.fix_hint: Send the API key of the Amplitude project, and keep it server-side.

params.name: events
params.description: Amplitude reads the events to ingest from this array.
params.fix_hint: Send an `events` array holding at least one event.

params.name: options
params.description: The vendor documents `options` in the request contract.

params.name: options.min_id_length
params.description: The vendor documents `options.min_id_length` in the request contract.
The vendor documents `` in the request contract.

params.name: events[].user_id
params.description: The vendor documents `events[].user_id` in the request contract.

params.name: events[].device_id
params.description: The vendor documents `events[].device_id` in the request contract.

rules.message: The request does not satisfy the documented identifier minimum length requirement.

params.name: event_type
params.description: Amplitude documents the event type as required on every event.
params.fix_hint: Name the event, such as `Purchase Completed`.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Amplitude documents user IDs as strings of 5 characters or more, and silently drops shorter ones unless `min_id_length` is set.
params.fix_hint: Use an identifier of at least 5 characters, or set the `min_id_length` option.

params.name: device_id
params.description: Amplitude documents device IDs as strings of 5 characters or more, and silently drops shorter ones unless `min_id_length` is set.
params.fix_hint: Use an identifier of at least 5 characters, or set the `min_id_length` option.

params.name: time
params.description: Amplitude documents this as milliseconds since epoch. A 10-digit value is seconds and lands in 1970.
params.fix_hint: Send milliseconds: a JavaScript `Date.now()` is already in the right unit.

params.name: insert_id
params.description: Amplitude uses it to drop duplicate events on retry.
params.fix_hint: Send a stable id per event so a retried upload is not counted twice.

params.name: ip
params.description: It is the user IP, sent unhashed, or `$remote` to use the request address.

params.name: user_agent
params.description: Send the original, unparsed and untruncated user agent as documented.

params.name: revenue
params.description: It is the event revenue. Amplitude documents a float and accepts negatives for refunds.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `129.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is the 3-character uppercase ISO 4217 currency of the purchase.
params.fix_hint: Use an uppercase code such as `USD`.

params.name: session_id
params.description: It is the session start time in milliseconds since epoch. Amplitude documents `-1` as the same as omitting it.

params.name: price
params.description: It is the price of the item purchased. Amplitude documents a float and accepts negatives for refunds.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `4.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: quantity
params.description: It is the quantity of the item purchased. Amplitude documents an integer and defaults to 1 when omitted.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number such as `3`.

params.name: productId
params.description: It identifies the item purchased. Amplitude documents sending price and quantity, or revenue, with this field.

params.name: revenueType
params.description: It is the type of revenue for the item purchased, such as `Refund`.

params.name: location_lat
params.description: It is the current latitude of the user. Amplitude documents a float.

params.name: location_lng
params.description: It is the current longitude of the user. Amplitude documents a float.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It is an incrementing counter Amplitude documents to distinguish events that share a `user_id` and timestamp.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number such as `23`.

params.name: app_version
params.description: It is the current version of the application.

params.name: platform
params.description: It is the platform of the device, such as `iOS`.

params.name: country
params.description: It is the current country of the user.

params.name: language
params.description: It is the language set by the user. Amplitude stores a language name; a tag such as `en-US` is accepted and rewritten.

params.name: idfa
params.description: It is the iOS Identifier for Advertiser. Amplitude's HTTP V2 samples send a UUID, and all-zero IDFAs are dropped.
params.fix_hint: Send `idfa` as a UUID, or omit the field.

params.name: idfv
params.description: It is the iOS Identifier for Vendor. Amplitude's HTTP V2 samples send a UUID.
params.fix_hint: Send `idfv` as a UUID, or omit the field.

params.name: adid
params.description: It is the Google Play Services advertising ID. Amplitude's HTTP V2 samples send a UUID.
params.fix_hint: Send `adid` as a UUID, or omit the field.

rules.message: The event carries neither `user_id` nor `device_id`. Amplitude documents one of the two as required, and rejects the event without them.
rules.fix_hint: Send `user_id` for a known user, or `device_id` for an anonymous one.

rules.message: The event type is one of the six event names that Amplitude reserves for internal use.
rules.fix_hint: Use an event name outside the six published reserved names.

rules.message: This IP value looks like a SHA-256 digest. Amplitude accepts a raw IP address or $remote.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address, or $remote to use the upload request address.

rules.message: This identifier is on Amplitude's list of values that return 400, such as `anonymous` or an all-zero UUID.
rules.fix_hint: Send a real `user_id` or `device_id` of at least 5 characters.
